```python
from itertools import product

# Evidence-based interpretation: an option qualifies only when its description
# establishes every element of the definition. An unstated benefit is not
# counted as an established benefit.
criteria = (
    "distinct service provider and recipient",
    "recipient contributes resources to the service system",
    "contribution improves the service or its management",
    "provider benefits",
    "recipient benefits",
)

options = {
    "A": {
        "text": "Parents clean classrooms for free, saving the school money.",
        "facts": (True, True, True, True, False),
        "reason": "Only the school's saving is stated; a reciprocal benefit "
                  "to participating parents is not established.",
    },
    "B": {
        "text": "Bookstore customers bring folding stools; customers appreciate "
                "the arrangement and bookstore sales improve.",
        "facts": (True, True, True, True, True),
        "reason": "Customers contribute seating, enjoy the arrangement, and "
                  "the bookstore gains sales.",
    },
    "C": {
        "text": "Lao Zhang dismisses the babysitter and does his own housework, "
                "getting exercise and saving money.",
        "facts": (False, False, False, False, True),
        "reason": "Self-service replaces the provider rather than integrating "
                  "the recipient into a continuing provider-recipient system.",
    },
    "D": {
        "text": "A supermarket rewards customers who bring environmentally "
                "friendly bags with electronic red envelopes.",
        "facts": (True, True, True, True, True),
        "reason": "Customers contribute packaging and receive rewards; the "
                  "supermarket advances its environmental and corporate-image goals.",
    },
}

# Exhaustively check that the rule requires every antecedent.
accepted_profiles = [
    profile for profile in product((False, True), repeat=len(criteria))
    if all(profile)
]
assert accepted_profiles == [(True,) * len(criteria)]

expected = set()
for letter, option in options.items():
    qualifies = all(option["facts"])
    if qualifies:
        expected.add(letter)
    print(f"{letter}: {option['text']}")
    print("  " + "; ".join(
        f"{criterion}={established}"
        for criterion, established in zip(criteria, option["facts"])
    ))
    print(f"  Qualifies={qualifies}. {option['reason']}")

submitted = {"B", "D"}
print("Expected under the stated-evidence reading:", ", ".join(sorted(expected)))
print("Submitted:", ", ".join(sorted(submitted)))
print("CHECK PASS" if submitted == expected else "CHECK FAIL")
```
